title: Freshchat Review (2026)
intro: Freshchat is evaluated here as a live chat and website messenger support platform — Freshchat is Freshworks' live chat and messaging platform for website and in-app customer support. Free plan for up to 10 agents; annual per-agent pricing: Growth $19, Pro $49, Enterprise $79 per agent/month billed annually. Distinct from Freshdesk (helpdesk) and Freshservice (ITSM). Scored as live-chat-support primary. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse's customer-service methodology (ease of use, support job fit, workflow depth, omnichannel, self-service, integrations, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Freshchat when live chat and messaging with a free 10-agent tier is the primary job within the Freshworks ecosystem.
verdict: Choose Freshchat when live chat and messaging with a free 10-agent tier is the primary job within the Freshworks ecosystem. Compare LiveChat for Text-powered chat depth and Tidio for conversation-cap SMB pricing with Lyro AI. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.
